text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, everyone!
Now then, today we have Fusaichi Pandora joining us as our guest!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: Speaking of Miss Pandora, she's had a dazzling career in the Triple Tiara and the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, but—

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: "First up, with a bang! Could you share your goals for this year with us?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yeees♡ My goal for this year is none other than...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Doing lots and lots of things
for Ai-chan's sakeâ¡

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-chan...? Um...
Excuse me, regarding the race goal—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha, are you watching, Ai-chan~?
I'll bring back souvenirs for you♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...New Year's. As for Fusaichi Pandora,
who seemed to be dying to do something
for Almond Eye's sake..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I had lost my way.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da♡
Here's the list of things I wanna do for you this month♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
First, cheering for them during training, right?
Making snacks for them, picking out their shoes, and stuff~

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then, what else~...
Hey, Trainer, got any ideas?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Most of the items on the list are assistance during training or various gifts. If I had to pick something else... what would I do?"
choice_data_list: ...How about going to a cooking class?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Broadening our culinary repertoire will improve the quality of our supplementary meals. It certainly won't hurt Fusaichi Pandora, and surely it will benefit Almond Eye as well.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
So it's one of those "boost your technique" things!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~, cooking works too, but...
Maybe I wanna come up with more ideas along those lines?
Gimme a sec~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora fiddled with her smartphone
for a bit... and listed a few classes. And then—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's boring alone,
won't you come with me, Trainer~?
choice_data_list: Making Osechi at a Cooking Class
Hair Arrangement Workshop Perfect for Kimono

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
She totally looks like she'd enjoy this kind of thing!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Let's give it a shot~☆

text_block_list.name: Cooking Class Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Today, we will be making traditional osechi cuisine.
Please take a look at the recipe. First, the three auspicious appetizers: tazukuri, kazunoko, and kuromame—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, yes, Sensei!
Can I put my own spin on the celebratory dishes?"

text_block_list.name: Cooking Class Teacher
text_block_list.text:
You're right... Since this is a classroom, I'd prefer if we followed the guidelines if possible.
Could I at least hear your idea first?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hamburg steak, fried shrimp, and tamagoyaki!
Plus chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Cooking Class Teacher
text_block_list.text: You must not.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Why, why?! It's way more fun that way!

text_block_list.name: Cooking Class Teacher
text_block_list.text: You must not.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Nbuh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And though a lot happened,
we were able to wrap up the workshop on a fun note."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha, sounds awesome!
Let's write the best calligraphy ever and give it to Ai-chan!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm actually pretty talented, you know♡
Mom and Dad have even kept my first calligraphy of the year
treasured all this time!

text_block_list.name: Kakizome Class Teacher
text_block_list.text:
“—Now then, without further ado,
please write your favorite character.
Anything is fine!”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Anything goes, huh.
Hmm, well then..."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I'll meditate and just go with
the first character that comes to mind♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, mmmm...!!
Mhhmmmmmmmmm!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —Ha!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —The ocean—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—...The god of...!
The "Sea God"!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't quite get it, but Fusaichi Pandora
enthusiastically wrote 'Sea God' on the calligraphy paper――"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: All done~♡

text_block_list.name: Kakizome Class Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, how wonderful.
It's a dynamic script, brimming with vitality.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Sensei praised me,
and the lesson ended on a fun note."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha, totally! Let's master it completely
and dress up Ai-chan♡

text_block_list.name: Hair Styling Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Looking great, everyone!
The key is feeling the groove!
Keep using those items, okay? ☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Feelings, feelings...
Mmm~! Ai-chan, Ai-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —Ta-da! Well?! Whaddya think, Teach?!

text_block_list.name: Hair Styling Teacher
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...!

text_block_list.name: Hair Styling Teacher
text_block_list.text: The overall balance is superb of course, but especially this braid combining lemon yellow and deep crimson, and the fluffy pom-pom right on top...!!

text_block_list.name: Hair Styling Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Too cuuute~~!
This is seriously gonna be the big trend this year!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe~♡
Thank you so much~♡

text_block_list.name: Hair Styling Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Um... how did you
come up with this idea?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I don't really get it. I was just thinking about Ai-chan,
and before I knew it, I'd pulled it off.

text_block_list.name: Hair Styling Teacher
text_block_list.text: A genius~?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I get that a lot~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Did you see that, Trainer?!
I got praised! Woohoo, I did it~♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Regardless, she continued to receive praise
from the teacher after that, and was able to
finish the class on a joyful note.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Here! A souvenir for youâ¡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you!
Did you go somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"The TV station♡ And homemade treats♡
I'll leave them over there, so eat them later, okay?♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'll come cheer for you during training after this too♡
Also, I bought shoes that'll be perfect for you, Ai-chan♡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on a second!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Um, what's all this all of a sudden? Souvenirs aside, why shoes...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
'Cause I wanted to give it to you, Ai-chan!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...W-Why?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, you're the one currently racing!
You should be buying your own shoes, not mine!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: *Gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh crap! Traineeer~!
I think I messed up somehowww!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Were those two just now Pandora-san and Ai-san?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"They were scurrying all over the place, wonder what happened...
Doesn't seem like they were fighting, though."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I'm curious about that recent live stream too.
...Hmm."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have a feeling this year will be hectic all over again, but...
Supporting her new dream, I want to sprint through the Twinkle Series with her.
